name: io.github.sweir1/apple-notes-brain
title: Apple Notes Brain
description: Apple Notes MCP server: read, write, and search Apple Notes on macOS with full Markdown round-trip. Reads via SQLite (sub-100ms, concurrent with Notes.app), writes via AppleScript (preserves iCloud sync). No plugin or fork required.

environmentVariables.name: NOTES_MCP_AUTO_REFRESH
environmentVariables.description: Set to '0' to disable the background auto-refresh thread that pings Notes.app to keep the SQLite cache fresh while the MCP client is active. Default '1' (enabled).

environmentVariables.name: NOTES_MCP_REFRESH_INTERVAL
environmentVariables.description: Background auto-refresh cadence in seconds (default 4, minimum 1). Lower = fresher reads of edits made outside the MCP, higher CPU. Has no effect on writes (those auto-flush regardless).

environmentVariables.name: NOTES_MCP_IDLE_THRESHOLD
environmentVariables.description: Seconds of MCP-tool inactivity before the background auto-refresh pauses (default 300 = 5 minutes). Set to 0 to disable idle pausing entirely. Next tool call instantly wakes the refresher.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_NOTES_BRAIN_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for the semantic-index SQLite DB and embedding model cache. Defaults to $XDG_DATA_HOME/apple-notes-brain or ~/.local/share/apple-notes-brain. Used only by the semantic+hybrid search tools (v1.1); has no effect without the [semantic] install extra.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_NOTES_BRAIN_MODEL_CACHE
environmentVariables.description: Directory for embedding model downloads. Defaults to <data_dir>/models. Maps onto huggingface_hub's cache layout so an existing HF cache can be reused.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_NOTES_BRAIN_NO_WATCH
environmentVariables.description: Set to '1' to disable the background semantic-index watcher that polls PRAGMA data_version. Default '0' (watcher enabled when [semantic] is installed).

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_NOTES_BRAIN_INDEX_INTERVAL
environmentVariables.description: Seconds between semantic-index watcher ticks (default 30, minimum 1). Ticks are cheap when nothing changed in NoteStore.sqlite — only a single data_version probe.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_NOTES_BRAIN_MAX_CHUNK_TOKENS
environmentVariables.description: Override the chunker's per-chunk token budget (computed at 2.5 chars/token). Defaults to the embedder's discovered/advertised max. Lower it if the embedder OOMs on long chunks.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_NOTES_BRAIN_DEBUG
environmentVariables.description: Set to '1' for verbose semantic-subsystem logging on stderr. Default '0'.

environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: Which embedder to use. 'onnx' (default, in-process ONNX with CoreML execution provider on macOS Apple Silicon) or 'ollama' (HTTP, expects an Ollama server at OLLAMA_BASE_URL). When paired with EMBEDDING_PRESET and the two disagree on provider, EMBEDDING_PROVIDER wins and a one-shot warning is emitted on stderr.

environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_PRESET
environmentVariables.description: Named embedding preset (mirrors obsidian-brain). 'english' (default, bge-small-en-v1.5, 384d), 'english-fast' (mdbr-leaf-ir, 384d), 'english-quality' (bge-base-en-v1.5, 768d), 'multilingual' (e5-small, 384d), 'multilingual-quality' (e5-base, 768d), or 'multilingual-ollama' (qwen3-embedding:0.6b via Ollama, 1024d). Sets provider + model atomically. EMBEDDING_MODEL overrides this when both are set.

environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Literal HuggingFace repo (e.g. 'Xenova/bge-small-en-v1.5') or Ollama model identifier. Overrides EMBEDDING_PRESET when both are set. Switching models forces a full re-embed on next indexing pass. Legacy short-names (bge-small-en-v1.5, bge-base-en-v1.5, all-MiniLM-L6-v2) still resolve to their canonical preset with a deprecation warning.

environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_DIM
environmentVariables.description: Override the embedder's output dimensionality. Auto-probed at init; only set this for non-standard models that don't auto-probe correctly.

environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_ONNX_PROVIDERS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated list of onnxruntime execution providers to try in order. Default on macOS: 'CoreMLExecutionProvider,CPUExecutionProvider'. Default elsewhere: 'CPUExecutionProvider'. Set 'CPUExecutionProvider' alone to force CPU on Apple Silicon (e.g. if CoreML EP misbehaves for a particular model).

environmentVariables.name: OLLAMA_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the local Ollama server (only used when EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=ollama). Default http://localhost:11434. Trailing slash is stripped.

environmentVariables.name: OLLAMA_NUM_CTX
environmentVariables.description: Override the context-window probe for the Ollama embedder. When unset, /api/show is queried; if num_ctx is unavailable, falls back to 8192.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_NOTES_BRAIN_OLLAMA_AUTO_PULL
environmentVariables.description: When EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=ollama and the configured model isn't present locally, '1' (default) auto-pulls it via /api/pull at boot; '0' refuses to start until the model exists.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_NOTES_BRAIN_NO_PREWARM
environmentVariables.description: Set to '1' to skip the AppleScript pre-warm ping at server startup. Pre-warm normally triggers the Automation permission prompt before any user-invoked tool call and wakes Notes.app so it flushes in-memory state. Useful in headless / CI contexts where there's no user to grant the prompt.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_NOTES_BRAIN_NO_CATCHUP
environmentVariables.description: Set to '1' to skip the catch-up semantic reindex on startup. Catch-up is normally run once on boot to bring the semantic index in sync with NoteStore.sqlite after a server restart. Has no effect without the [semantic] install extra.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_NOTES_BRAIN_CONFIG_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for user-config overrides (model-overrides.json, etc.). Defaults to $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/apple-notes-brain or ~/.config/apple-notes-brain. Read at startup to layer over bundled / fetched model metadata.
